info.title: Ledgerline API
info.description: Local statement analyzer. Binds 127.0.0.1 and has no authentication: it is a single-user process holding every statement its owner has imported.

rowIndexes.description: Present on `zero_amount_rows`: the rows that parsed to $0.00.

get.summary: Liveness, schema version, and any profile that failed to load at boot

post.summary: Upload one or more statement files
post.description: Stages and parses; commits nothing. A byte-identical re-upload returns the existing import untouched (spec 3.3, idempotency layer one).

get.description: Rows with their disposition, the exact duplicates the merge rule will absorb, the near-duplicates needing a three-way choice, unparsed rows, and the balance verdict (spec 6.1). The plan is null until an account is confirmed.

patch.summary: Confirm the account, override the profile, or re-parse
patch.description: Refused once the import is committed (spec 6.1).

delete.description: Removes only the transactions this import is the last remaining source for. Deleting the first of two overlapping imports keeps the rows the second still contains (spec 3.3).

post.description: Idempotent. Applies the multiset merge rule, then the near-duplicate resolutions, then refund pairing — all inside one transaction, so a partial import never lands (spec 3.3, 2.5).

allowZeroAmountRows.description: Store $0 rows as trial authorizations. Without it a non-pending $0 row is refused as a probable misparse (spec 3.2).

get.description: Internal transfers are excluded unless asked for — a credit-card payment is not spending (spec 6.3). `hasFinding` comes from `finding_evidence` (spec 2.3).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text across raw and normalized descriptors

get.summary: One transaction, with the imports that cover it
get.description: The covering imports and the verbatim line are spec 6.3’s row expander. `rawText` is the statement line as printed, never trimmed or re-encoded (spec 2.5).

patch.summary: Assign merchant or category, mark internal transfer, exclude
patch.description: A merchant assignment writes a `user` merchant_alias and enqueues a coalesced re-normalize job (spec 4.3, 2.7).

post.summary: Apply one change to a filter-matched set
post.description: `?dryRun=true` returns the match count only and writes nothing — this is what backs spec 6.3’s "apply to all 47 matching descriptors". A real apply of a merchant writes one `user` merchant_alias per matched descriptor (spec 4.3) and enqueues a coalesced re-normalize job (spec 2.7).

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: Count the matched set and write nothing

get.description: Includes provisional merchants — spec 4.1 step 7 makes an unresolved descriptor a `source = "rule"` merchant, and `source` is what the UI shows to distinguish one from a seeded merchant (spec 7.5).
Spec 2.7: the UI polls this rather than blocking on the work.

post.summary: Write a consistent copy of the database
post.description: Uses SQLite’s online backup rather than a file copy: under WAL the `.sqlite` file alone is not the whole database, so copying it while the API is running can miss the most recent commits.

post.summary: Export every transaction as JSON or CSV
post.description: Money is exported twice on purpose: `amountCents` is the value, and `amount` is the rendered form for a human reading the file. Only the first is ever read back.

tags.name: imports
tags.description: Upload, review, commit and delete statement imports
